'''Umber Scale''', or '''Umbra Scale''', as it was preferred to be called by the [[Kimogila Fanatics]], was an area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] in the [[Karthakk system]]. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the Kimogila Fanatics had conquered the territory, stealing it away from the [[Blood Razors]] and pushing them back to the other side of the [[Spine of Lok]]. The once-peaceful [[Star system/Legends|space system]] of [[Lok/Legends|Lok]], by now riddled with war, often prevented civilians and [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] from passing through the area unharmed.

A [[Space station/Legends|space station]] was located within the Umber Scale territory.
